From a month-long backlog to same-week delivery

Vitko — Overwatch 2 & Marvel Rivals order tracking system
01
The problem
Orders had accumulated inside the general queue without a clear way to distinguish rank, role, or platform.
02
The intervention
I built a live, color-coded tracking sheet that separated the backlog into clear, actionable categories and could be updated by the team in real time.
03
The execution
The tracker turned an unclear pile of orders into a visible workflow the team could work through systematically.
04
The result
A month-long backlog was cleared within days, while the tracker gave the team a repeatable way to see what was pending and what was finished.
05
Beyond the tracker
Clearing it wasn't limited to the sheet. It meant creating and linking new accounts myself whenever access was the actual blocker, and staying on well past my shift on the days the backlog demanded it — because the queue doesn't move until someone moves it.
Why this matters for customer support: the value was not just closing orders. It was identifying the process problem behind the queue and building a simple system that made execution easier for everyone.
